method: All 560 candidates inspected in fourteen 40-image contact sheets; captions inspected for ambiguous cases. Not full-resolution annotation of every image.

excluded_ids.181816: Statue rather than a live person
excluded_ids.65350: Fall/contact at skate park is ambiguous
excluded_ids.97924: Forceful animal handling outside target benign people scope

accepted_label: no visible interpersonal assault in reviewed scene; not a claim of general safety
license_filter: COCO per-image license ids 4 and 5: CC BY 2.0 and CC BY-SA 2.0
limits: Some person annotations refer to partial bodies or small/background people. Crowd means >=5 annotated instances, not necessarily >=5 large foreground people. Close means bounding-box area >=20%, not measured physical distance.
